activities_catalog.name: Louvre Museum Masterpieces Guided Tour
activities_catalog.description: Skip the line to see the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and Winged Victory.

activities_catalog.name: Eiffel Tower Summit by Elevator & Champagne
activities_catalog.description: Ascend to the highest observation deck in Paris for breathtaking panoramic views.

activities_catalog.name: Montmartre Secret Bakeries & Wine Walking Tour
activities_catalog.description: Taste artisanal baguettes, artisan cheeses, cured meats, and local wines.

activities_catalog.name: Seine River Sunset Dinner Cruise
activities_catalog.description: Enjoy a 3-course French dinner with live violin as Paris lights illuminate around you.

activities_catalog.name: Shibuya Crossing & Harajuku Street Fashion Walk
activities_catalog.description: Experience the world’s busiest pedestrian crossing and pop-culture street fashion.

activities_catalog.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Sushi & Street Food Safari
activities_catalog.description: Savor fresh sea urchin, wagyu beef skewers, tamagoyaki, and premium nigiri sushi.

activities_catalog.name: Akihabara Retro Arcade & Electronics Tour
activities_catalog.description: Dive into maid cafes, multi-level retro gaming centers, and hobbyist electronics.

activities_catalog.name: Ubud Sacred Monkey Forest & Tegallalang Rice Terrace
activities_catalog.description: Wander among playful macaques in lush ancient jungle and swing over emerald rice paddies.

activities_catalog.name: Mount Batur Sunrise Volcano Hike & Hot Springs
activities_catalog.description: Trek up an active volcano before dawn for sunrise above the clouds, followed by mineral springs.

activities_catalog.name: Traditional Balinese Cooking Class at Organic Farm
activities_catalog.description: Pick fresh herbs and cook satay lilit, gado-gado, and spicy sambal with a local family.

activities_catalog.name: Empire State Building 86th Floor Observatory
activities_catalog.description: Enjoy 360-degree open-air views of Manhattan from the quintessential Art Deco skyscraper.

activities_catalog.name: Chelsea Market & High Line Park Walking Tour
activities_catalog.description: Stroll along elevated rail tracks lined with wildflowers and sample gourmet Chelsea bites.

activities_catalog.name: Broadway Musical Evening Ticket (Lion King / Wicked)
activities_catalog.description: Immerse yourself in theatrical spectacle in the heart of Times Square.

activities_catalog.name: Colosseum, Roman Forum & Palatine Hill Priority Access
activities_catalog.description: Walk through gladiatorial arenas and ancient emperor palaces with an archaeologist guide.

activities_catalog.name: Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter’s Basilica
activities_catalog.description: Marvel at Michelangelo’s famous ceiling and Rafael’s Renaissance frescoes.

activities_catalog.name: Trastevere Sunset Pasta & Tiramisu Masterclass
activities_catalog.description: Make fresh fettuccine and authentic Roman carbonara paired with Chianti red wine.

activities_catalog.name: Tower of London & Crown Jewels Exhibition
activities_catalog.description: Discover nearly 1,000 years of royal intrigue, ravens, and dazzling crown diamonds.

activities_catalog.name: Borough Market British Food & Craft Cider Tour
activities_catalog.description: Sample Scotch eggs, artisanal Neal’s Yard cheeses, sausage rolls, and sweet fudge.

activities_catalog.name: British Museum Ancient Egypt & Rosetta Stone Walk
activities_catalog.description: Explore world history from the Parthenon sculptures to Egyptian mummies.

activities_catalog.name: Sydney Opera House Behind-the-Scenes Architectural Tour
activities_catalog.description: Go inside the world-famous sails and discover the engineering genius of Jørn Utzon.

activities_catalog.name: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Clifftop Trek
activities_catalog.description: Breathtaking 6km coastal trail passing dramatic cliffs, rock pools, and Tamarama beach.

activities_catalog.name: Sydney Harbour Sunset Catamaran Cruise
activities_catalog.description: Sip champagne with panoramic views of the Harbour Bridge and Opera House at dusk.

activities_catalog.name: Burj Khalifa Level 124 & 125 At The Top
activities_catalog.description: Stand on the observation deck of the world’s tallest skyscraper.

activities_catalog.name: Red Dune 4x4 Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner & Show
activities_catalog.description: Thrilling sandboarding, camel rides, belly dancing show, and buffet banquet.

activities_catalog.name: Old Dubai Souks & Abra Boat Crossing
activities_catalog.description: Explore glittering Gold Souk, fragrant Spice Souk, and cross the Creek on traditional boat.

activities_catalog.name: Sagrada Família Towers & Fast-Track Guided Tour
activities_catalog.description: Witness Gaudí’s stained-glass forest and take elevators up to the Nativity towers.

activities_catalog.name: Park Güell Mosaic Serpent & Monumental Zone
activities_catalog.description: Fairytale gardens and vibrantly tiled benches overlooking Barcelona and the sea.

activities_catalog.name: Gothic Quarter Evening Tapas & Cava Crawl
activities_catalog.description: Sample patatas bravas, Iberian jamón, crispy croquetas, and sparkling Catalan cava.

activities_catalog.name: Grand Palace & Wat Phra Kaew (Emerald Buddha)
activities_catalog.description: The historic seat of the Siamese royal court, covered in golden mosaics.

activities_catalog.name: Damnoen Saduak Floating Market & Longtail Boat
activities_catalog.description: Glide past wooden canoes piled high with fresh mangoes, coconut pancakes, and noodles.

activities_catalog.name: Chinatown (Yaowarat) Midnight Tuk-Tuk Food Tour
activities_catalog.description: Zip through neon alleys to taste guay tiew noodles, toasted buns, and pad thai.

activities_catalog.name: Table Mountain Cable Car & Summit Nature Trail
activities_catalog.description: Revolving cable car ride to flat-top mountain peaks with sweeping Atlantic views.

activities_catalog.name: Cape Peninsula & Boulders Beach African Penguin Colony
activities_catalog.description: Drive Chapman’s Peak, stand at Cape of Good Hope, and watch penguins waddle on white sands.

activities_catalog.name: Stellenbosch Historic Wine Tasting & Cellar Tour
activities_catalog.description: Sample world-renowned Pinotage and Chenin Blanc across scenic Dutch-colonial estates.

activities_catalog.name: Christ the Redeemer by Cogwheel Train through Tijuca Forest
activities_catalog.description: Travel through Atlantic rainforest to the towering Art Deco statue atop Corcovado mountain.

activities_catalog.name: Sugarloaf Mountain Cable Car at Golden Hour
activities_catalog.description: Glass-walled cable car offering sunset views over Guanabara Bay and Copacabana beach.

activities_catalog.name: Samba School Night Rehearsal Experience
activities_catalog.description: Feel the thunderous percussive heartbeat of Rio Carnival at a top-tier samba school.

cities.name: Paris
cities.description: The City of Light dazzles with iconic architecture, haute cuisine, world-class art at the Louvre, and romantic Seine river cruises.

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.description: An exhilarating blend of neon-lit skyscrapers and historic temples, celebrated for unmatched gastronomy, anime culture, and peaceful gardens.

cities.name: Bali
cities.description: Island of the Gods featuring lush terraced rice paddies, volcanic peaks, sacred water temples, and world-class surfing beaches.

cities.name: New York
cities.description: The city that never sleeps, famous for Central Park, Broadway shows, world-renowned skyline, and vibrant multicultural neighborhoods.

cities.name: Rome
cities.description: The Eternal City where ancient history comes alive through the Colosseum, Vatican City, and winding cobblestone streets filled with pasta trattorias.

cities.name: London
cities.description: A global metropolis bridging royal tradition and modern creativity, from the Tower of London and West End theatres to lively riverside markets.

cities.name: Sydney
cities.description: Sun-drenched harbor city known for the architectural masterpiece Sydney Opera House, Bondi coastal walks, and vibrant harbor ferries.

cities.name: Dubai
cities.description: Futuristic oasis of luxury, featuring the record-breaking Burj Khalifa, desert dune safaris, indoor ski slopes, and sprawling souks.

cities.name: Barcelona
cities.description: Mediterranean gem brimming with Antoni Gaudí’s surreal masterpieces like Sagrada Família, sandy city beaches, and late-night tapas bars.

cities.name: Bangkok
cities.description: Vibrant street life, ornate floating shrines, bustling night markets, and Michelin-starred street food stalls that never sleep.

cities.name: Cape Town
cities.description: Dramatic coastal scenery flanked by Table Mountain, penguin beaches at Boulders, world-class Cape winelands, and scenic ocean drives.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro
cities.description: Samba rhythms, golden stretches of Copacabana and Ipanema beaches, and the awe-inspiring Christ the Redeemer overlooking Sugarloaf Mountain.

trip_notes.title: Paris Arrival & Hotel Check-in Details
trip_notes.content: Door code is #4829A, then press Bell 4. Host Marie will leave the keys in the lockbox. Pick up Navigo Easy metro cards at Gare du Nord station.

trip_notes.title: Eiffel Tower Sunset Tips
trip_notes.content: Arrive at Security Gate 1 at least 45 minutes before reservation time. Bring photo ID matching booking voucher #FR-PAR-9921.

trip_notes.title: FCO Airport to Rome Center
trip_notes.content: Take the non-stop Leonardo Express train directly from Fiumicino Airport to Roma Termini (runs every 15 min, 14 EUR). Avoid unofficial street taxis.
